name: Scarlett DeMeo
biography: Scarlett DeMeo (formerly known professionally as ‘Samantha Cormier’) is a versatile actress known for her dynamic presence and ability to deeply connect with her characters. She is perhaps most recognized for her roles in the HBO Max series “Minx” (2022) and the critically acclaimed FX series “Legion” (2019), as well as her film work alongside Denzel Washington in “The Little Things” (2021). Her career demonstrates remarkable range across genres, from drama to comedy and action, making her one of the most promising talents in the industry.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
